t.7681-52-9.agn: The label states that it releases a toxic gas in contact with acids (EUH031). The Turkish Ministry of Health advises against mixing it with acidic products such as hydrochloric acid, or with ammonia; mixing produces gases such as chlorine and chloramines.
t.7681-52-9.pw.0: Gases that irritate the airways may be released; do not use in a closed space, keep the room ventilated.
t.7681-52-9.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 017-011-00-1 (ATP13): Skin Corr. 1B, Eye Dam. 1, Aquatic Acute 1, Aquatic Chronic 1. Supplemental label statement: EUH031.
t.7681-52-9.summary: The active ingredient of household bleach; a chlorine bleach and disinfectant.
t.7681-52-9.what: Whitens stains by oxidising them and kills germs.
t.tem.h.EUH031: EUH031 Contact with acids liberates toxic gas.
